channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Iran conflict ‘war between good and evil’ – Israeli opposition leader
item.description: We spoke to the Israeli opposition leader Yair Lapid from the centrist Yesh Atid party.

item.title: Does Donald Trump have a clear plan for Iran?
item.description: The fallout of the US-Israeli strikes is rippling across the Middle East, so what exactly is Donald Trump's plan?

item.title: ‘Extraordinarily difficult’ for Iranian people to overthrow regime, says former US ambassador
item.description: We were joined by former US Ambassador to Lebanon David Satterfield.

item.title: Iranian forces assert domestic control after ayatollah’s death
item.description: The death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei has fractured Iran’s leadership, with a temporary council of clerics and the Revolutionary Guard still in control.

item.title: Who’s in charge in Iran after Ayatollah Khamenei’s death?
item.description: Now the Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and other senior Iranian figures are dead, where does this leave the regime?

item.title: Trump’s attacks ‘uniting Iran’, says Iranian professor
item.description: We spoke to Foad Izadi, who is a professor of political studies at Tehran University and is a supporter of the Iranian government, and began by asking him who was in charge now in Iran.

item.title: At least 52 killed in new Israeli strikes on Hezbollah in Lebanon
item.description: In Lebanon, a new front opened in the conflict after Hezbollah targeted Israel's military base in Haifa with rockets and drones and Israel responded with its jets bombing the suburbs of Beirut killing at least 52 people, according to Lebanese officials.

item.title: UK will not take offensive action against Iran, says Starmer
item.description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer told MPs that he "does not believe in regime change from the skies".

item.title: ‘We’re supporting British interests in the region’, says defence minister
item.description: We spoke to the defence minister Al Carns and asked him, after Keir Starmer's words today, whether Britain could now say whether the US attack on Iran was legal or not.

item.title: What the widening Middle East conflict means for global oil prices
item.description: Gas and oil prices soared on the news that Iran had managed to hit energy facilities in Saudi Arabia and Qatar.
